title: kinetite
description: This mod adds a new alloy called kinetite which is crafted using charged copper, iron and water
body:
OVERVIEW
If you've ever wanted an alloy in minecraft this mod has got you covered. This mod adds a new resource to minecraft called kinetite. Its crafted by combining charged copper, iron and water in a crafting table
## ADDED CONTENT
### ITEMS
- SWORD
- KNIFE
- SHOVEL
- PICKAXE
- AXE
- HOE
### ARMOR
- HELMET
- CHESTPLATE
- LEGGINGS
- BOOTS
- Full set bonus effect
## Installation
Drop the jar file into your mods folder and run minecraft with fabric installed

### Other
You can do whatever u want with this mod but I request you credit me This was originally supposed to be titanium but I changed it to steel so the mod id is titanium I have no plans to continue to work on this mod
